name: gSaveMetadata
notes: Save metadata buffer; first 8 bytes are the CRAWSAVE signature, byte 8 is slot count, byte 16+slot is the per-slot valid flag

name: gSaveSlotHeaders
notes: Three 12-byte save slot headers; byte 0 of each is the validity marker

name: gVBlankState
notes: Set to 1 before waiting for VBlank; cleared by the VBlank handler

name: gDisplayState
notes: Zeroed during display reset and in GameInit; exact role unconfirmed

name: gBiosIrqFlags
notes: BIOS interrupt check flags (IntrWait); handlers OR their bit here

name: gActiveMenuItemCount
notes: Number of visible menu entries written by BuildActiveMenuItems

name: gActiveMenuItems
notes: Twenty pointers to the currently visible menu entries

name: gMenuFlags
notes: Menu flag bitfield tested by IsMenuFlagSet

name: gMenuPositionX
notes: Menu horizontal position computed by BuildActiveMenuItems

name: gMenuRuntimeState
notes: Cleared alongside gMenuFlags in ResetMenuState; role unconfirmed

name: gAsyncState
notes: Nonzero suppresses the fifth VBlank transfer step; role unconfirmed

name: gGameState
notes: Game state block; byte 12 selects the VBlank frame-delay behaviour

name: gFrameDelay
notes: IWRAM frame delay written each VBlank, clamped to five

name: gIwramFrameCounter
notes: IWRAM frame counter copied into gFrameDelay then cleared

name: gRegIf
notes: REG_IF interrupt acknowledge register
